steps.name: gate
steps.summary: lib/gate.ts — viewScope(plan)과 gateReport(plan, summary, txns). free는 transactions 길이 0 + lockedTxnCount + insights 앞 3개, summary 합계는 그대로. 알 수 없는 plan은 free. 순수 함수 — plan은 라우트가 DB에서 읽어 넘긴다

steps.name: analysis-pipeline
steps.summary: lib/analysis/run-analysis.ts — runAnalysis(userId, uploadId). Storage→decode/parse→fingerprint→format cache (LLM only on miss)→normalize→dictionary cache (LLM only for misses)→dictionary upsert→transaction replacement→aggregate→upload completion; never rejects, maps failures to fixed error codes, and logs metadata only.

steps.name: uploads-ingest
steps.summary: app/api/uploads/route.ts — POST(runtime nodejs, maxDuration 300): 인증→확장자/2MB→fileHash→중복 409(+existingUploadId, Storage 미사용)→Storage {userId}/{id}.csv→INSERT(실패 시 객체 보상 삭제)→202 {id}→after(runAnalysis). GET: 자기 업로드 100건, created_at desc, 거래행/전체인사이트 미포함

steps.name: uploads-detail
steps.summary: app/api/uploads/[id]/route.ts — GET은 부재·타인을 동일한 404로 처리하고 서버 plan에 따라 free 거래 조회를 생략하며, DELETE는 Storage→DB 순서와 cascade를 보장한다.

steps.name: uploads-retry
steps.summary: app/api/uploads/[id]/retry/route.ts — POST: user-scoped 404, expiry-first rejection, failed-state and retry-limit checks, atomic retry transition, 202 with retriesLeft, then after(runAnalysis); no advisory lock.
